original_question: Sara tana son siyawa kanta sabuwar jaket da takalmi guda 2. Jaket din da ta ke so ya kai $30 kuma kowane takalmin ya kai $20. Sara tana renon yaran makwabciyarta sau 4, tana samun $5 a duk lokacin da ta raine su. Iyayenta suna biyan ta $4 a duk lokacin da ta yanka ciyawa. Idan Sara ta riga ta tanadi $10 kafin ta fara renon yara, sau nawa ne za ta yi yankan ciyawar kafin ta iya samun jaket da takalman?
